headline: Weathered Expanse Ignites While Base Contests Persist Across Northern Sectors
war_summary: Combat intensity has flared sharply in Weathered Expanse, where nine strategic base transitions occurred over the past two hours, leaving three positions in no-man's-land amid continuous tactical exchanges. Mooring County also experienced renewed volatility at The Wind Hills, logging three base events in the latest two-hour stretch. In contrast, the rapid stronghold turnover previously observed in Marban Hollow and Linn of Mercy has cooled during recent hours, though Linn of Mercy recorded another base transition alongside over seven hundred combined casualties in the latest two-hour span. Nevish Line continues to see mounting bloodletting with casualty rates accelerating on both sides despite no immediate base transfers, while heavy ongoing attrition persists without territorial shifts in Callahan's Passage and Stonecradle. Stlican Shelf and the remaining northern sectors show reduced activity, and the southern interior remains quiet.
